parts.text: Search the transfer policy. What is the daily limit and fee? Cite the policy ID.

eval_cases.context: POL-001: Internal simulated transfers have a cumulative $500 USD limit per UTC calendar day for C001 within one active session, across all owned source accounts. Transfers update only the session-local simulated balances and ledger. A new session resets the ledger and limit; this is not a cross-session banking limit. Transfers require explicit authorization of the source, destination, and amount. There is no transfer fee.

parts.text: Search the support hours policy. Does it promise weekend support? Cite the policy ID.

eval_cases.context: POL-002: Support is available Monday through Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 UTC. No weekend support is promised.
